spec.assertion: it.skip + a positive assertion that NO 3.56% critRatePct grant is ever emitted. The scope-lock fight is one immortal partless raid boss that never dies, and no TriggerDef expresses 'on enemy kill', so the line is structurally unreachable. Nearest-wrong: keying it to `passive` / `hitCount` / `interval` to 'make it do something' — that would emit 3.56% grants this assertion catches, and would silently invent uptime the kit never gives.

Unobservable — target-set correctness (alliesTopAtk count 2, byFinalAtk true because the text literally says 'final ATK') cannot be discriminated while the trigger never fires. Recorded in spec for authoring correctness; asserted only as the absence of any grant. NOTE for the driver: authoring must still use byFinalAtk:true (live effectiveAtk ranking), not static ranking — 'final ATK' is the literal-word test.
Unscoped critRatePct, durationSec 5 (seconds, literally stated). Inert at scope lock; the magnitude/duration pair is pinned only by the negative assertion above.

Proves fullBurstEnter: every 45.93% buffApply frame is a member of the fullBurstStart frame set. Nearest-wrong is burstCast — neon is Burst I, so her cast frame lands strictly BEFORE the FB window opens; the frame-membership check fails outright under that keying, and the CF_BURSTCAST counterfactual additionally shows her total damage diverges (the buffed shots fall outside Full Burst, losing the +50% major on the crit-lifted hits). Also correct-by-taxonomy: 'beginning of Full Burst' fires on ANY team Full Burst, so it must NOT carry ownBurstGate.

Proves target {kind:'allies'} with no excludeSelf: the set of distinct targetSlugs equals the full comp size (4) and includes 'neon', with each ally receiving exactly one application per Full Burst. Nearest-wrong models — excludeSelf:true (3 recipients, neon absent) or alliesTopAtk/alliesOfClass (fewer recipients) — all fail the size + membership + per-slug-count checks.

Proves stat 'critRatePct' (UNSCOPED) at raw percentage value 45.93 — a plain percentage stat, so the emitted value is the kit percentage, not a flat-resolved number. Nearest-wrong is critRateNormalPct (taxonomy #1, and the documented helm failure): the stat filter finds zero events under that key, and CF_SCOPED proves it is not cosmetic — re-scoping moves neon's total, because scoping away skill/burst crit strips the lift from her own 528.97% burst nuke and from every ally's skill/burst damage. Filter safety: helm occupies the fixed B3 slot and carries critRateNormalPct, a different key, so it cannot forge or mask neon's events; casterIdx pinning is belt-and-braces.

Proves durationShots === 2 on every application — a ROUND count that expires after the HOLDER fires 2 rounds and therefore spans reloads and stretches/shrinks with each ally's own cadence. Nearest-wrong is durationSec:2 (taxonomy #2, the single most common blind error): CF_SECONDS pins that the two readings are not interchangeable by asserting whole-comp total damage diverges. The distinction is material here — recipients span an SG (9 rounds, slow), and fast-firing allies would burn 2 rounds far inside 2 seconds while a slow holder would still be on round 1 after it.

Proves a flatDamage of 528.97 atkPct on a burstCast trigger, landing in the BURST bucket exactly once per neon burst cast, with fbMajorApplied === false (burst-cast damage is always FB-exempt — it resolves before the FB window opens, per taxonomy #9 and the verified-facts block). CF_NO_NUKE discriminates magnitude-bearing presence: removing it strictly lowers neon and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Nearest-wrong models caught: (a) hit-count/interval keying → hit count ≠ cast count; (b) crediting the +50% FB major → fbMajorApplied true; (c) routing it through the skill bucket → bucket check.

Scope-trivial: the scope-lock boss is a single partless enemy, so 'highest final DEF' resolves to the only target. Asserted as the ABSENCE of fan-out — the burst-bucket damage count equals the cast count exactly, never a multiple of it. Nearest-wrong: authoring a per-enemy repeat or duplicating the effect, which the count equality catches. Authoring note: target {kind:'enemy'}.

Proves target {kind:'alliesOfWeapon', weapon:'SG'} with no excludeSelf — every maxAmmoFlat recipient's weapon is 'SG', and neon herself is a recipient. Nearest-wrong models: plain 'allies' (a non-SG recipient appears → weapon check fails), alliesOfClass 'Supporter' (weapon-typed lines are class-BLIND — a Supporter AR ally would wrongly receive it, an SG Attacker would wrongly miss it), or excludeSelf:true (neon absent). Paired inertness assertion: removing the grant leaves every non-SG teammate byte-identical, proving the grant's reach is exactly the SG set.

Proves stat 'maxAmmoFlat' value 3 (a FLAT round count — NOT maxAmmoPct, which could only approximate '▲ 3 round(s)') with durationSec 10 and durationShots undefined (a wall-clock window here, unlike skill2's round count — the two duration semantics coexist in this kit and must not be cross-contaminated). Critically it also proves the line IS DAMAGE (taxonomy #6: weapon-state modifiers gate shots fired): CF_NO_AMMO strictly lowers neon's total, because +3 on a 9-round magazine with a 129-frame reload buys extra shots inside her own burst window. Nearest-wrong: dispositioning it 'ignored/defensive' or dropping it as a utility line — the strict-inequality assertion fails under removal, so a silent skip cannot pass.

fixtures: controlComp('neon', true) for all six runs — liter (B1) / crown (B2) / neon (carry, focus, middle slot) / helm (fixed B3). neon is Burst I and cannot chain alone, so B2+B3 coverage is mandatory or the comp makes ZERO Full Bursts and every skill2 assertion is silently vacuous (the burst-eligibility rule); a non-vacuity test asserts fullBurstStart count > 0 before any FB-keyed claim is read. The fixed B3 slot is KEPT rather than passed false: helm's confounding crit line is critRateNormalPct — a distinct StatKey from neon's unscoped critRatePct — so it can neither forge nor mask neon's events, and casterIdx===2 pinning makes the filter exact regardless. Five in-memory withPatchedOverride counterfactuals supply the nearest-wrong comparisons (crit re-scoped to normal-only; '2 shots' re-read as 2 seconds; FB-enter re-keyed to burstCast; burst nuke removed; SG ammo grant removed); committed JSON is never touched and validate-overrides is not run (parallel-run tree discipline). 6 full 180 s sims total.
gaps: skill1 (whole skill) — it.skip: 'Activates when killing an enemy' is unreachable at scope lock. The fight is a single immortal partless raid boss that never dies, and no TriggerDef in the schema expresses an on-kill event, so the 3.56%/5 s crit grant to the 2 highest-final-ATK allies cannot fire or be observed. Modeled for kit completeness only; the test asserts its ABSENCE (no 3.56% critRatePct event) so a wrong-trigger 'fix' that manufactures uptime goes RED. Recipe to close: none available in v1 — it needs an enemy-death event the sim has no concept of; it stays permanently inert for solo raid and should be documented in the override note, not shimmed.

skill1 target ranking — byFinalAtk:true ('highest final ATK' is literal) vs static ATK ranking is UNDISCRIMINABLE while the trigger never fires. Flagged for authoring correctness; no assertion can distinguish the two at scope lock.

NOT a gap but a ⚑ for the driver: neon's SG cadence tuple (pullsPerSec) and reloadFrames 129 come from datamine fields on the known-unreliable list. The ammo-grant assertion is deliberately a STRICT INEQUALITY (removal lowers her total), never an absolute shot count or damage magnitude, so it stays valid under any cadence correction. Recipe if a magnitude pin is ever wanted: an ammo-counter read off a focus recording (shots/sec measured directly), not an FB-count read (downstream of gauge).
